description_en: A brown-grey form broadens above and below a narrowed, twisted waist against white. Dense horizontal ribs wrap around its larger folds, a shallow opening marks the upper edge, and the dark right contour contrasts with a brighter left surface across the nearly full-height object.

title_zh: 《无》：书法笔画错位叠层局部
title_en: Wu: displaced layers of calligraphic strokes
description_zh: 米褐色底上，黑色毛笔字被切分为大小不同的矩形，部分笔画在相邻图块之间偏移重叠。红色印章痕迹散布左侧与字间，纸面纹理隐约可见，图像展示书写形态的拼接局部而非清晰连贯的全文。
description_en: Black calligraphic characters are broken into unequal rectangles over a beige-brown ground. Strokes shift and overlap between neighbouring blocks, with red seal traces scattered among them. Faint paper texture remains visible in a fragmentary view rather than a continuous readable text.

title_zh: 我｜皮肤上交错的深色毛发
title_en: I | Crossing dark hairs above skin
description_zh: 多根深色毛发在极近距离中交错，长短不一的线条穿过暖棕色皮肤背景，部分毛发超出画框。焦点在几根前方线条上较为清楚，后方纹理轻微虚化，细小身体材料被放大成线与底面的关系。
description_en: Several dark hairs cross at extreme close range over a warm brown field of skin. Their differing lengths extend beyond the crop. A few forward strands are sharply focused while the underlying texture softens slightly, enlarging a small bodily surface into a relation between fine lines and their ground.

description_zh: 画面紧贴一块暖褐色皮肤，纵横细纹、密集毛孔和多根黑色短毛被放大。亮光在表面形成许多细小白点，毛发朝不同方向弯曲，图像没有完整五官或可判定身体部位的外部轮廓。

title_zh: 无｜细密交织灯体的星形亮口

title_en: Green peaks  —  960-pixel work-page image

description_en: The 960-pixel work-page image preserves a clear division between pale sky and grey-black peaks above green woodland and yellow-brown slopes. Dense photographic rectangles repeat foliage, rocks and clouds, while the distant overall view still resolves into an uneven horizontal mountain range.

description_en: Rectangular photographs form an inward-turning ring around a snowy centre. Brown wall panels, roofs and makeshift structures encircle the clearing. Bare trees radiate along the perimeter, where varied angles and straight seams create an irregular outline.

description_en: Several pale-gold folds extend diagonally across the black background, each rim turning outwards above the next. title_zh: 《人像——杨辰》：鼻与嘴唇细节
title_en: Portrait — Yang Chen: nose and lips detail
description_zh: 暖色近景把鼻部置于上半部，闭合的嘴唇横向占据下方。鼻翼、唇部纹路与周围细小胡须均可辨，右侧逐渐陷入暗部，裁切排除了眼睛和面孔外缘，突出皮肤表面的起伏。
description_en: A warm close-up places the nose above closed lips. Nostril contours, lip lines and fine facial hairs remain visible. The right side darkens, while the tight crop excludes the eyes and outer facial outline to emphasise surface relief.

title_zh: 上下错开的双叶褶体
title_en: Offset upper and lower folded lobes

description_en: A small brown-grey form consists of two swollen leaf-like lobes linked by a visibly narrowed centre against a white square. title_zh: 山崖边的两人和独立靴子
title_en: Two figures and separate boots beside a cliff
description_zh: 棕褐旧照片风格的虚构山景里，左侧长衣人物弯膝张开双手，右侧有胡须的人蹲地抬头看着他。两只独立靴子从中央地面竖起，身后小队列通向陡峭崖壁，远处雪山与湖面横贯背景，细针叶树夹在人物之间。
description_en: In a fictional sepia mountain scene, a long-coated person at left bends their knees with hands spread before a crouching bearded figure at right. Two separate boots rise from the ground between them, with tiny distant people, conifers, steep cliffs, snowy peaks and a lake completing the backdrop.

title_zh: 山重水复｜透明重叠与位移后的山石
title_en: Shanshui | Rocks after transparent overlap and displacement
description_zh: 多层山石照片以不同透明度和位置相互覆盖，左侧松枝与右侧岩壁大致相接，外围却留下多级矩形边缘。部分天空和岩面像薄片般重叠，局部清晰度随透明层改变，位移与叠加同时参与了空间的构成。
description_en: Several rock photographs overlap at different positions and opacities. Pine branches at the left and a rock wall at the right broadly join, but stepped rectangular edges remain around the perimeter. Sky and stone appear in translucent layers, with local clarity changing across them, making both displacement and overlap part of the spatial construction.

title_en: Human Surrender / Shoot Self with You | Bespectacled figure beside the sheeting
description_zh: 竖斜的半透明材料占据左半画面，一位戴圆框眼镜的人从材料右侧探身进入视野，手靠在颈部附近。脸部朝向较低位置，背景仅剩浅色墙面与暗处物件，材料边缘造成明显的遮挡和窄幅观看通道。
description_en: A diagonal edge of translucent material fills the left half of the image. A person wearing round glasses leans into view from its right side, with a hand close to the neck. The face points downward against a pale wall and dim objects, while the sheeting creates a narrow, partially obstructed sightline.

title_zh: 多方向卷曲的褶皱形体
title_en: Folded form curling in several directions
description_zh: 白色背景中央的棕灰形体向多个方向翻卷，上方形成空心管口，左右与底部伸出弯曲叶片般的褶面。表面细横纹随各部分扭转，深色阴影集中在凹槽内部，外轮廓呈不规则团块。
description_en: A brown-grey form curls in several directions at the centre of a white field, with a hollow upper opening and bent, leaf-like folds projecting sideways and below. Fine horizontal ribs follow each twist, while dark recesses separate the irregular lobes and the open tube.

title_zh: 空黑箱里的三处光斑
title_en: Three pools of light in an empty black box
description_zh: 宽阔黑色舞台没有人物，后方长幕布垂直落地。地面中央有小片白光，左右墙面各留一块弧形投影，右侧光斑较大；顶部几块长方形结构微微显亮，反光地板把空间向前延伸。
description_en: An empty black stage stretches towards a full-height rear curtain, with a small white pool of light at centre and curved patches on the side walls. The larger right-hand patch, faint rectangular overhead elements and reflective floor establish the otherwise dark room's depth.

title_zh: 荧绿底上的单帧三狗姿态

description_zh: 荧绿色正方形里，紫红细线小狗以拟人姿态站立，一臂向左上举起，另一臂弯在胸前，头部向右倾斜。圆点眼睛和小圆嘴留在头部中央，下方细长腿线与尾部线条分开，画面没有文字或环境背景。
description_en: A magenta outline dog stands in a human-like pose against vivid green, raising one arm towards the upper left while bending the other across its chest. Its head tilts right around dotted eyes and a small round mouth, above separated long leg and tail lines without text or scenery.

title_zh: 格物工作室｜十二水灯｜竖向波纹包裹的椭圆灯体
title_en: Gewu Studio / Twelve Water Lamps | Oval light wrapped in vertical waves
description_zh: 暖黄色椭圆灯体悬置在纯黑背景中，数道宽阔的弯曲沟槽自下向上绕行，细密平行层纹沿沟槽转折。上端较圆，下缘略收拢并露出明亮开口，光从表面和边缘透出，强调弯曲壳体的厚薄变化。
description_en: A warm yellow oval light appears against a black background. Broad curved grooves sweep upward around the form, with fine parallel ridges following each turn. The top is rounded and the lower edge narrows around a bright opening, making variations in the curved shell visible through its surface glow.

title_en: Screen proposal built from layered wavy lines
description_zh: 白底效果图把一组浅灰绿色细线叠成竖向屏风形体，上下边缘呈起伏波浪，中间向左右鼓出并局部收细。不同高度的曲线前后穿插，间隙透出白色背景，底部多层细线逐渐归拢，整体没有人物或环境参照。
description_en: A white-background rendering stacks pale grey-green wavy lines into an upright screen form, swelling sideways around narrowed sections. Curves at different heights overlap across open white gaps, with layered lines gathering near the base and no people or surrounding room to establish physical scale.

description_zh: 一只眼睛占据近处画面，眉毛沿上方展开，深色金属镜框从左向右弯过眼睑，透明鼻托和连接件位于左侧。皮肤、睫毛与镜片反光同时被记录，画面裁掉完整鼻梁和另一只眼，使眼镜也成为局部结构。
description_en: A single eye fills the close view beneath an eyebrow. A dark metal spectacle frame curves across the eyelid, with its transparent nose pad and connector visible at the left. title_zh: 背向镜头的持烛者与围观人群
title_en: Candle holder seen from behind within a group
description_zh: 画面中央前景的人背向镜头，烛火在右肩旁发出橙色亮点，周围站着一圈或明或暗的人。后墙植物投影照出左上几张面孔，近处人物的头肩几乎全是剪影，手中手机和纸张只留下小片反光。
description_en: A foreground figure faces away from the camera, with an orange candle flame glowing beside their right shoulder among surrounding people. Projected vegetation lights several faces at upper left, while nearby heads and shoulders remain silhouettes interrupted by small reflections from phones and papers.

title_zh: 《Fafalish》：长墙纸本陈列的室内全景
title_en: Fafalish: wide view of paper display along a wall
description_zh: 宽阔室内视角里，黑白纸张沿后墙连续铺开，上方灰色通风管与长条灯平行延伸。近处木桌摆有纸本、盒子和奖杯状物件，中间黑色椅子错落排列，远端电脑与高脚凳靠向左侧。
description_en: A wide interior view shows black-and-white sheets extending along the rear wall beneath ventilation ducts and strip lights. Papers, boxes and a trophy-like object occupy a foreground wooden table. Black chairs, computers and stools recede toward the left.

title_zh: 何发论紫袍辩论家
title_en: He Fa on The Purple-robed Debater

title_zh: 中央｜密集山林拼贴全幅
title_en: Central  —  Full composition of a dense landscape collage
description_zh: 《中央》的文章JPG几乎被灰绿照片碎块铺满，山林与尖峰没有退到远处天空下，而是在整幅内部反复叠合。中下部褐色条带穿过密集白灰块，右下夹一小片蓝色，局部亮圆点隐在树林间，整体较绿色山重水复更近、更满。
description_en: The article JPEG of Central is densely filled with grey-green photographic fragments, repeating woodland and pointed forms throughout rather than placing peaks beneath open sky. A brown band descends through pale blocks near the lower centre, with small blue areas and a light circular point embedded among trees.

description_zh: 灯罩局部几乎填满竖向画面，成排细纹沿宽窄不同的褶面向上扭转，沟槽在亮金色表面留下深色弧线。左侧与右上角露出黑色背景，画面没有展示整只灯具，而集中表现表面曲率与纹理密度。
description_en: A tightly cropped section of the shade fills the vertical image with fine ribs twisting along broad folds. Dark curved grooves interrupt the glowing gold surface, while black remains at the left and upper-right edges, concentrating attention on changing curvature and dense texture rather than the complete lamp.

title_zh: 《四维人》：手持相机的黑衣人物
title_en: Four-Dimensional People: black jacket and camera
description_zh: 浅灰色底中，黑衣人物低头站立，手中握着相机，颈侧垂下一条红边背带。人物从头至脚由数段矩形照片错位接起，后方汽车与道路也随之分断，下部接片逐级缩窄。

title_zh: 持烛与抬手的人物近景
title_en: Close view of a candle and a raised hand
description_zh: 短发人物穿着前襟打结的白衬衫站在左侧，一手举白色蜡烛，另一手弯指抬起。右侧长发人物在胸前拿着纸页，后方还有两张脸从暗处露出，投影文字碎片落在衣服和灰墙上。
description_en: A short-haired person in a front-tied white shirt holds a white candle at left and raises the other hand with curved fingers. A long-haired person holds a paper at chest height on the right, while two faces and fragments of projected text emerge behind them.

title_zh: 文字纸页覆盖的工作室墙面
title_en: Studio wall covered with printed pages
description_zh: 长条墙面被不同大小的白色文字纸页覆盖，展示从左侧电脑桌一直延伸到右方。木桌上另放耳机和说明板，空椅分布其间；上方粗大的深灰通风管横穿画面，天窗日光照亮白墙和纸张。
description_en: Printed white pages in varied sizes cover a long wall above desks, extending from computer workstations at left to the right edge. Headphones and a text board occupy a wooden table between empty chairs, beneath a large grey ventilation duct and daylight from the skylight.

title_zh: 展开纸页与远处烛光
title_en: Open papers and distant candlelight
description_zh: 近景左侧一名长发人物手持展开的纸页与小型物件，身旁灰墙映出深色头部轮廓。中间一人背向镜头站着，右后方烛光照亮另一张低头面孔，投影与门边竖线把暗室分成不均匀的明暗区域。
description_en: A long-haired foreground person at left holds open papers and a small object beside a dark head-shaped wall shadow. Another person stands with their back to the camera near the centre, while candlelight reveals a lowered face at rear right among uneven projected light and vertical doorway lines.

description_zh: 明黄色薄染铺在纸面上部，前景有蓝灰色大人形，左侧粉红轮廓与深色伸臂形体相互交叠。人物面部只以少量色块表示，身体边界沿水痕散开，画面下方逐渐转为灰白和蓝色。
description_en: A thin yellow wash fills the upper paper above a large blue-gray foreground figure. Pink outlines overlap a darker outstretched form on the left. Sparse colour patches suggest faces, while watery body edges dissolve toward gray-white and blue below.

title_zh: 蜡烛与墙上的水面二字
title_en: Candle beside the projected word 水面
description_zh: 左前景穿白衣的人侧背对镜头，手中高举一支点燃的白色蜡烛，火焰成为画面最亮处。灰墙下部投出“水面”二字，右侧一人沉在暗处看着手机，近景烛光与后方文字之间留出大片空墙。
description_en: A white-clothed person seen partly from behind raises a burning candle at left, its flame the brightest point in the frame. The Chinese word 水面 is projected low on the grey wall beside a dark figure looking at a phone, separated by a broad empty surface.

title_zh: 横向分布的方块灯具方案
title_en: Lighting proposal with horizontally distributed cubes
description_zh: 纯黑横幅中央偏右悬着一组发白光的方块，细长吊线从上缘垂直落下，方块在中心上下错落并向两侧伸展。透明线框盒与实心灰块穿插其间，物体面积很小，四周大面积黑色突出灯组的横向分布。
description_en: A small group of glowing white cubes hangs right of centre in a broad black field from a thin vertical suspension line. The cubes step above and below the centre and extend sideways among transparent wireframe boxes and solid grey blocks, emphasising their horizontal distribution within surrounding darkness.

title_zh: 白色羽状构件的双幅效果图
title_en: Paired renderings of a white feather-like structure
description_zh: 两幅效果图左右并置：左侧深色人台头部斜戴白色编织状构件，细条从边缘向上展开；右侧把相同构件单独放在黑底上。网状下部、长短不一的白色杆线和弯曲轮廓清楚可见，左图还保留“Cornices”字样。
description_en: Two renderings sit side by side: a dark mannequin head wears an angled white woven structure at left, while the object appears alone on black at right. Its mesh-like lower section and unequal upward-extending rods define a curved outline beneath the visible Cornices label.

description_zh: 固定广角画面把红色躺椅和浅色浴池并排展开，一位人物靠在左侧椅上，另一位坐于右后方水中台阶。池沿自近处斜向深处延伸，蓝色小圆物沿边缘分布，墙柱与后方扶手共同提示了两人之间的距离。
description_en: A fixed wide-angle view places red reclining chairs beside a pale tiled pool. One person rests on a chair at the left and another sits on the submerged steps at the rear right. The pool edge extends diagonally into depth, with small blue rounded objects, columns and handrails marking the distance between them.

title_zh: 地面烛光与后方整排人群

description_zh: 一支蜡烛在前景地面独自发亮，后方人群沿墙站成半圈，面孔大多隐入暗处。左墙投出绿色草地与浅色栏杆的画面，几双鞋在烛光后方露出，宽阔黑色地面把火焰与人群之间的距离拉开。
description_en: A candle glows alone on the foreground floor before a loose semicircle of standing people whose faces remain mostly dark. Green grass and a pale railing are projected on the left wall, while visible shoes and a broad dark floor emphasise the distance between flame and group.

title_en: Human Surrender / Shoot Self with You | Three people facing inward before a dark curtain
description_zh: 三个人物围成近距离的交谈构图：左边的人抱着粉红色靠垫，中间戴眼镜者盘腿坐着，一只手托在下巴附近；右边侧脸贴近镜头并张口。后方黑幕几乎占满背景，使视线、手势和人物间距离更突出。
description_en: Three people form a closely spaced conversational arrangement before a dark curtain. The figure at the left holds a pink cushion; the bespectacled person in the middle sits cross-legged with a hand near the chin. A face close to the camera at the right has an open mouth, concentrating attention on gazes, gestures and distances.

title_zh: 竹林与白色楼房的叠影
title_en: Superimposed bamboo and white building
description_zh: 一条小路朝远处白色多层楼房延伸，两侧竹竿、木栏与绿叶形成纵深，路上有一个浅色衣服的人。半透明矩形画面叠在其上，左侧留下黑边，建筑与植物在不同清晰度的层次中同时显现。
description_en: A path leads towards a distant white multi-storey building between bamboo, wooden railings and foliage, with a pale-clothed figure on the route. Semi-transparent rectangular layers overlap the scene beside a black left margin, combining the architecture and vegetation at different degrees of clarity.

title_zh: 尖锐折面堆叠的形体
title_en: Form composed of sharply folded surfaces
description_zh: 白底上，一个棕灰色复杂团块占据较大面积，多块三角折面和尖角向不同方向刺出。部分边缘翻转露出深色内面，细纹在尖锐折线附近被拉成不同方向，整体轮廓呈横向展开的棱角状。
description_en: A large brown-grey mass spreads across a white background, composed of triangular folds and sharp points projecting in different directions. title_zh: 纵向错叠的方块灯具方案
title_en: Lighting proposal with vertically staggered cubes
description_zh: 黑色背景里，一根长吊线连接上下拉长的灯组，数个明亮方块沿竖向错开，中间穿插灰色实块和透明细框。最上与最下的亮块相隔较远，白光边缘与深黑留白对比鲜明，构图强调垂直延伸和层层连接。
description_en: A long suspension line supports an elongated lighting group against black, with several bright cubes staggered vertically among grey solid blocks and transparent fine frames. Widely separated upper and lower lights, crisp glowing edges and broad dark margins emphasise the assembly's vertical extension and layered connections.

title_zh: 《眼界》：密集车流与城市楼群
title_en: Field of View: dense traffic and city blocks
description_zh: 宽阔路面上密集排列汽车，多车道从画面底部向中间收束。两侧楼群和路灯被复制为多层条带，灰色天空在上方断续拼接；照片重复改变了道路宽度，使中央车流形成放射状结构。
description_en: Cars fill a broad multilane road that narrows toward the middle. Buildings and streetlights repeat in layered strips on both sides beneath a broken gray sky. Photographic duplication changes the apparent road width into a radiating traffic pattern.

title_zh: 共同的节日叠字换色动画海报
title_en: Changing-colour layered-type poster for A Common Festival
description_zh: 黑色竖版海报以多层“共同的节日”大字互相遮叠，字色在荧绿、蓝、紫、粉红与黄色之间轮换，背景还有细线空心字。下方日期时间行与“钱江世纪公园大草坪”同步换色，保持同一排版，画面不含人物或照片。
description_en: A black vertical animated poster overlaps multiple oversized Chinese title layers for A Common Festival, cycling through lime, blue, purple, pink and yellow over thin outlined lettering. The date-time line and Qianjiang Century Park lawn text change colour within a fixed layout without figures or photographs.

title_zh: 纸板服装与折纸鹅的黑白场景
title_en: Black-and-white scene with cardboard costume and paper goose
description_zh: 黑白虚构舞台中，一人戴高纸帽、穿圆筒纸板服装坐在右侧椅上，左边另一人蹲下伸手靠近一只折纸鹅。小纸鸟悬在头顶，纸片散落于地，幕布与木架在后方形成暗背景，纸板折线和人物关节构成机械般的层次。
description_en: A fictional black-and-white stage shows a seated person in a tall paper hat and cylindrical cardboard costume beside someone crouching towards an origami goose. description_en: Dense rows of small photographs repeat views of a road junction, cars, buses and pedestrians. White and yellow vehicles interrupt the gray roadway. Occasional foreground heads and shifted alignments break the otherwise regular traffic grid.

description_en: Pale peaks and sky occupy the upper half, above dark green and ochre woodland. Many small rectangular photographs overlap. Tree trunks and rocky contours appear intermittently through the layered texture across the complete horizontal composition.

title_zh: 人类投降派｜近距离的白色覆盖材料
title_en: Human Surrender / Shoot Self with You | White covering material at close range
description_zh: 白色薄膜或布料在近处鼓起，细长深色线条散布在表面，褶皱斜向伸展。材料下方仅从边缘露出身体的一小部分，左侧浅色挡板压缩了视野；画面主要提供覆盖物纹理与透光程度的局部记录。
description_en: White cloth or sheeting bulges close to the lens, with thin dark lines scattered across its surface and wrinkles running diagonally. Only a small part of a body appears at the edge below. A pale panel at the left narrows the view, leaving a local record of the covering material’s texture and translucency.

title_zh: 发光曲面与内壁条纹的近景
title_en: Close-up of luminous opening and ribbed inner surface
description_zh: 极近视角里，深浅相间的曲线条纹覆盖整个灯体内壁，向左下方一处亮白开口汇聚。开口边缘呈多层波浪，右侧大块褐黄色暗面弯曲延伸，画面突出重复细纹与内外明暗的差别。
description_en: An extreme close view follows alternating ridges across a curved inner surface toward a bright opening at lower left. Layered waves shape its edge. A broad brown-yellow shadow curves along the right, emphasising repeated ribs and the contrast between interior and light.

title_zh: 黑底上的两幅并置风景
title_en: Two landscapes placed side by side on black
description_zh: 纯黑横幅中央并排放着两块宽银幕画面，左边是云天下的绿色山坡，右边是竹林间的小路与白色楼房。两块影像之间留出窄黑缝，右侧又可见淡淡矩形叠层，大片黑色上下边缘强化了并置关系。
description_en: Two wide landscape images sit side by side within a black horizontal field: green hills beneath clouds at left, and a bamboo-lined path towards a white building at right. A narrow black gap and faint rectangular overlays separate the pictures within broad dark upper and lower margins.

title_zh: 紧凑聚合的方块灯具方案
title_en: Lighting proposal with a compact cluster of cubes
description_zh: 黑色横幅中央偏左，一组白色发光方块围着吊线紧凑聚拢，中央实块被几层透明方框穿插。左右两侧各伸出小框，底部有深灰方块，灯组外围保留大片黑色留白，整体轮廓接近横向短十字。
description_en: A compact group of white glowing cubes gathers around a suspension line slightly left of centre within a black horizontal frame. Transparent square outlines intersect the solid central blocks and extend sideways above darker lower cubes, producing a short cross-like silhouette surrounded by generous empty space.

title_en: Three-person conversation  —  Full-frame article JPEG
description_zh: 这张2800像素宽的文章JPG保留三人围坐的完整横幅：左侧橙红裙人物与右侧条纹衬衫人物互相面对，中央眼镜人物张口坐在黄绿光中。下方双手、脚踝与席面较完整，前后身体之间留出一大片黑色间隔。
description_en: The 2800-pixel article JPEG preserves the full horizontal seated scene: the orange-red and striped figures face across a darker interval around the central glasses-wearing person in yellow-green light. title_zh: 《影子对位法》：绿光与红光的上下剧照
title_en: Shadow Counterpoint: stacked green and red stage photographs
description_zh: 竖幅把两张舞台照片上下叠放，上图绿色灯光中一人站在垂线旁，地面右侧有伏下的浅色形体。下图变成红光，人物靠近中央幕口与地上物件；两图均以黑暗包围小块亮区，形成明显色彩对照。
description_en: Two stage photographs are stacked vertically. Above, green light reveals a standing figure beside a descending line and a low pale form on the right. Below, red light surrounds a figure near the curtain opening and floor objects, sharply contrasting the upper scene.

title_zh: 山重水复｜局部照片被打乱的网格
title_en: Shanshui | Grid of displaced photographic sections
description_zh: 原先连续的石壁、松树与天空被切成矩形小块后重新混排，单个小块内部仍像照片，边缘却与邻块频繁错接。蓝白天空片段插入山石中央，绿色枝叶也不再沿原有树干连续，打散顺序成为主要可见变化。
description_en: Rectangular sections of rock, pine and sky are rearranged into a grid. Each piece remains photographic inside its edges, but adjacent pieces repeatedly fail to align. description_zh: 黑白横幅展示一个无人的黑盒舞台，右后方斜落的白光在地面形成近似矩形亮区，光束中带有薄雾。左边还露出小片地面光，顶部空调与长方灯具淡淡显现，墙、地面和天花之间的接缝构成封闭透视。
description_en: A black-and-white overview shows an empty black-box stage with a diagonal white beam falling from the rear right into a roughly rectangular floor patch. Thin haze reveals the beam beneath faint ceiling fixtures and air-conditioning units, while wall seams establish the enclosed perspective around the dark floor.

title_zh: 格物工作室｜产品与空间实验｜环形截面与直立骨架研究
title_en: Gewu Studio / Products and Spatial Experiments | Ring sections and upright framework studies
description_zh: 白色设计页上方写有“形态研究”，下方分成三组：从单一环形轮廓、密集环线到填黑的截面，再对应不同密度的直立线框。细长曲线在下排交叉成柱状或屏状体积，版面把截面变化与整体骨架并列。
description_en: The white design page is headed 形态研究. Three upper groups move from a simple ring outline through denser loops to a darkened section, each paired with an upright framework below. title_zh: YourTube｜密集弹幕覆盖中央面孔
title_en: YourTube | Dense comments obscuring a central face
description_zh: 不同颜色与大小的弹幕几乎铺满整幅横向屏幕，白色文字最为密集，红、绿、蓝、紫色字行穿插其间。中央隐约留有一张人脸，轮廓被重复文字遮挡，屏幕图像与观看者输入的文字在同一平面竞争可见度。
description_en: Scrolling comments of different colors and sizes nearly fill the horizontal screen. Dense white text is interrupted by red, green, blue and purple lines. title_zh: 暖光灯罩的波浪开口
title_en: Undulating opening of a warmly lit shade
description_zh: 黑色背景中，一只浅金色灯罩从上方垂下，宽大的弧面向四周鼓起，底部开口呈不规则波浪。内部光源照亮开口边缘，表面的细密颗粒与宽阔褶皱同时显露，物体外缘被画面上方裁切。
description_en: Against black, a pale-gold lampshade hangs into the frame with broad curved surfaces swelling outwards above an irregular wavy opening. Light from inside brightens the lower rim, revealing fine grain and larger folds, while the top of the form extends beyond the image.

title_zh: 格物工作室｜十二水灯｜横向波峰反复折转
title_en: Gewu Studio / Twelve Water Lamps | Repeated folded wave crests
description_zh: 横向展开的发光壳体表面有连续折返的波峰，几组较宽的折带自左上朝右下弯曲，形成近似锯齿的节奏。两端不完全对称，下缘向中央收出尖部，细层纹沿大折带转折，暖黄轮廓与黑底分明。
description_en: Repeated folds ripple across a horizontally extended luminous shell. Broad bands bend from upper left toward lower right in a near-zigzag rhythm. title_zh: 秋色树木与蓝天的密集拼贴
title_en: Dense collage of autumn trees and blue sky
description_zh: 蓝色天空下，褐黄与橙色树冠从下方向上铺满画面，少量暗绿穿插其间。密集小矩形在天空里最容易辨认，树干和枝条被层层错位叠加，中央与右侧较高的树形仍保留完整轮廓。
description_en: Brown, yellow and orange tree crowns fill the frame beneath blue sky, interspersed with dark green. Small rectangles are especially visible overhead. Layered trunks and branches shift repeatedly while taller central and right-hand trees retain their broad outlines.

description_en: A narrow top opens into a broad bell-like body. Large curved panels sweep diagonally around it and gather into waves along the irregular lower edge. title_zh: 宽褶灯罩与GLOW STUDIO字样
title_en: Broad folded shade with GLOW STUDIO lettering
description_zh: 横幅黑底中，浅金色灯罩偏左悬挂，宽阔褶面向两侧鼓起，底部较窄的开口向内透出亮光。少量细密纹理沿壳体延展，右下角可辨“GLOW STUDIO”及其倒影式文字，物体外缘完整。
description_en: A pale-gold lampshade hangs left of centre against a black horizontal field, its broad folds swelling sideways above a smaller illuminated opening. Fine surface texture follows the shell, and GLOW STUDIO lettering with a reflected repetition appears at lower right beside the complete outline.

title_zh: 荧绿色发字网站图标
title_en: Lime-green 发 website icon
description_zh: 小型正方形图标以纯黑为底，中央单独放置一枚荧黄绿色“发”字。字形的斜笔与弯曲笔画保留明显粗细变化，笔画间黑色空隙与四周黑边连在一起，没有其他文字、照片或边框，识别点完全落在单字与高对比配色上。
description_en: A small square website icon places a single lime-yellow Chinese character 发 at the centre of a black field. Slanted and curved strokes vary in thickness around clear dark counters, with no other text, photograph or border competing with the high-contrast one-character mark.

title_en: Translucent photographic layers of trees in snow
description_zh: 横幅画面中，几株无叶树木在雪地上左右分布，最右侧树冠较大，中央有低矮石块和蜿蜒空地。浅灰天空与白色地面被无数半透明矩形覆盖，树干和枝条在接缝中重复、错位。
description_en: Bare trees stand across snowy ground in a horizontal montage, with a larger crown on the right and low rocks near the centre. Countless translucent rectangles layer the pale sky and snow, repeating and displacing trunks and branches.

title_en: Complete narrative board for Time Canyon
description_zh: 竖向白底思维图左列排参考小图，并用分支归入“失败、排泄、死亡、出生、命运”等大字。中央“时间峡谷”节点向右连到蓝色“消失的尾巴”和红色“蜂王的故事”，细虚线跨接左右，右边分别附文字段落，整体留有大量空白。
description_en: A tall white narrative board places reference thumbnails along the left under large Chinese categories including failure, excretion, death, birth and fate. The central Time Canyon node branches right towards blue and red story headings, linked by fine dashed cross-connections beside paragraphs and broad open areas.

title_zh: 幻浪灯罩的扭褶全貌
title_en: Twisting full form of the Huanlang shade
description_zh: 黑色背景里，一只宽体浅金灯罩呈不对称扭褶，左侧较直，右侧鼓出弧面，底缘向内收拢成波浪线。细密斜纹覆盖整个壳体，内部光线照出柔和明暗，顶部仅露出细短悬线。
description_en: Against black, a broad pale-gold shade twists asymmetrically, with a straighter left edge, swelling right side and inward-curving wavy base. title_zh: 横向椭圆波纹灯体
title_en: Horizontal oval light with rippled surface
description_zh: 黑色背景里，扁宽的浅黄色灯体呈近椭圆形，表面有成排斜向细纹与扭转波浪。底部偏左的开口透出白色亮光，顶部隐约有一根细吊线，外缘不规则起伏，整体横向展开。
description_en: A broad, flattened pale-yellow light hangs against black, its oval body covered with diagonal ridges and twisting waves. White light escapes through an opening near the lower left. A fine suspension line is faintly visible above the uneven outer edge.

title_zh: 《鸡尾酒》：蓝灰山景的细格拼接
title_en: Cocktail: fine-grid montage of blue-gray landscape
description_zh: 大量细小照片把横幅铺成密集网状，蓝灰天空与山峰占据上部，绿色与褐色地景聚在下方。每张照片边缘仍清晰，局部大小、方向不同，使原本连贯的山水被拆成颜色与形状的连续变化。
description_en: Numerous tiny photographs fill a dense horizontal mesh, with blue-gray sky and peaks above green-brown ground. Each image retains a sharp border. Differences in scale and orientation break the landscape into continuous variations of colour and shape.

title_zh: 人类投降派｜座椅区与水面间的空走道
title_en: Human Surrender / Shoot Self with You | Empty walkway between chairs and water
description_zh: 左侧躺椅上的人物与右后方浴池中的人物仍相隔一段空走道，浅色瓷砖和池沿形成清楚的分界。近处蓝色圆物、地面的拖鞋以及后墙更衣区图标都被纳入广角视野，身体之外的设施细节保持可见。
description_en: An empty tiled walkway continues between the person on the left reclining chair and the figure in the rear of the pool. The pool rim makes a clear boundary. A blue rounded object near the camera, slippers on the floor and a changing-area sign on the rear wall remain visible within the wide view.

title_zh: 格物工作室｜十二水灯｜纵向褶纹汇向偏侧亮口
title_en: Gewu Studio / Twelve Water Lamps | Vertical pleats converging on an offset opening
description_zh: 上部较饱满的灯体被纵向细褶分割，两侧曲面向下收拢，在右下方形成偏斜的宽亮口。左侧轮廓缓慢弯曲，右侧则更紧密地旋合，表面暖黄与开口白光相对照，突出形体不均衡的收束方式。
description_en: Fine vertical pleats divide a full upper body, with curved sides narrowing toward a broad opening tilted to the lower right. The left outline bends gradually while the right gathers more tightly. Warm yellow surfaces contrast with the whiter opening, making the unequal convergence of the form clearly visible.

title_zh: 多行彩色矩形的横向色板
title_en: Horizontal chart of coloured rectangles
description_zh: 长横幅由多行等高矩形拼成，每格填入纯蓝、黄、绿、粉、橙、灰或黑色。浅褐细边把色格分隔，颜色没有渐变而是跳跃交替，整齐网格外围略带红褐色边框，画面没有文字或具象物件。
description_en: Rows of equally tall rectangles form a long horizontal colour chart. Solid blue, yellow, green, pink, orange, gray and black cells alternate abruptly. Thin brown dividers and an outer reddish edge structure the regular grid without text or representational objects.

description_en: Translucent white membranes stretch towards a bright round light above, their folds radiating around the rear centre. A pale-clothed person sits at left behind a foreground rail and hanging fabric, while a cropped body enters at right under cool white and faint blue illumination.

title_zh: 格物工作室｜十二水灯｜层片横绕的扁圆悬灯
title_en: Gewu Studio / Twelve Water Lamps | Flattened suspended light with circling layers
description_zh: 灯体横向铺展，顶部细线与较扁的圆形外轮廓相接，连续片层绕着中心旋转。各层的厚薄和阴影清楚，边缘略有凹凸，底部没有完全张开的宽口，温暖光线主要从层片表面均匀散出。
description_en: A fine line meets the top of a broad flattened round body. Continuous layers circle around its center, with their thicknesses and shadows clearly visible. The slightly uneven perimeter and comparatively closed lower surface distinguish it from more open shades; warm light spreads mainly across the layered exterior.

description_en: Several people sit cross-legged along a grey-black wall, facing a dark-clothed figure standing with their back to the camera at front right. Overhead light catches the central floor and pale clothing, while cropped bodies and deep shadows frame the seated gathering.

title_zh: 山重水复｜横向展开的石景拼合过程
title_en: Shanshui | Landscape fragments spread horizontally
description_zh: 横向画面中，岩石、草木和天空的照片片段以不同尺寸拼接，形成松散的山石与树丛走向。纯黑空隙不断打断图像，部分石块边缘和蓝色天空仍呈孤立碎片，能清楚辨认局部照片与整体空间之间尚未收拢的关系。
description_en: In a horizontal frame, photographic pieces of rocks, vegetation and sky overlap at different scales, loosely suggesting rocky slopes and groups of trees. Black gaps repeatedly interrupt the surface. Some rock edges and blue-sky sections remain isolated, making the unresolved relationship between local photographs and the emerging space clearly visible.

title_zh: 我｜皮肤微距中的起伏与反光
title_en: I | Surface variation and highlights in a skin macro
description_zh: 满幅皮肤微距中可见细小圆点、毛孔状凹陷和不均匀的表面起伏，局部有较亮的油润反光，短细毛散落其间。画面没有其他物件或身份线索，色调由浅暖色到较深棕红渐变，重点在表面质地而非完整五官。
description_en: A skin macro fills the entire frame with small rounded marks, pore-like depressions and uneven surface relief. Brighter highlights and short fine hairs interrupt the texture. No objects or identifying facial arrangement remain; warm pale tones deepen toward brown-red, concentrating attention on the surface rather than complete facial features.

title_zh: 黑底蜂窝波纹的发光形体
title_en: Luminous form with honeycomb-like ripples on black
description_zh: 黑色方形底中，一团浅黄色灯体从上部向下收拢，表面密布旋转状凹凸波纹。下方开口发出更亮的奶白色光，开口边缘呈不规则星形，左右轮廓略有起伏，细密纹理沿曲面连续变化。
description_en: A pale-yellow luminous body narrows downward against a black square. Dense rotating ridges create a honeycomb-like surface. A brighter creamy opening below has an irregular star-shaped edge, while the surrounding ripples change direction continuously across the curved form.

title_zh: 《哈姆雷特的镜子》草图：多层灰黑框架与人物
title_en: Hamlet’s Mirror sketch: layered dark frames and figures
description_zh: 白纸上多层灰黑色框架向上收拢，蓝色与红色小人形分散在各层之间。中央偏下有红色竖向形体，底边坐落一个褐色人形轮廓，墨色与水色在连接处晕开，构图近似层层叠起的舞台示意。
description_en: Layered gray-black frames narrow upward across white paper, with small blue and red figures between them. A red vertical form stands near the lower centre above a brown figure at the edge. Spreading washes give the arrangement a tiered stage-like structure.
